title: DexVantage hardware library entry
description: One device of the hardware library (dexvantage/core/library, docs/models/library.md). Every figure comes from a cited source (sources); a figure the maker does not state is null, shown as 'not stated by the maker'. Units: metres, degrees, millimetres where the key says _mm, watts, grams. Poses are the imager's OPTICAL frame (z forward, x right, y down) in the device body frame (REP-103: x forward along the optical axis, y left, z up, origin at the optical centre of the reference (depth) imager); quaternions are (x, y, z, w).

url.description: The URL, or the document's name and number when it has no URL.

read.description: The date the source was read (YYYY-MM-DD).

note.description: What the sources do not state, assumptions (labelled as such) and anything odd, such as two sources that disagree.

price.description: Optional (core/prices.py, docs/models/library.md#prices): the price of one unit as the maker's own online store or official price list states it on the date read; null (or absent) when no such page states one. Never estimated; no exchange rate is applied. amount is null when the price depends on an option the entry does not fix (options lists each). A custom entry may give 'value' instead of 'amount' (the older form).

amount.description: The price of one unit (unit 'each'), as stated, without tax or shipping.

value.description: The older name of amount (custom entries).

currency.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code, as the page states it.

kind.description: maker_store: a list price from the maker's own online store; maker_price_list: the maker's official price list page; reseller: a store the maker sells only through (said in 'what').

source.description: The URL of the page the price was read from.

read.description: The date the price was read (YYYY-MM-DD).

region.description: The store or market the price belongs to (for example 'US'), as the page shows it.

min_quantity.description: Optional: the quantity the price is for when it is a volume price (NVIDIA's '1KU+' is 1000).

sale_amount.description: Optional: a temporary sale price shown on the date read (amount is the regular price).

what.description: The page's words: product, variant, SKU, availability.

options.description: Other variants and their prices, as stated (a cable's lengths, a kit).

sync.description: Optional (core/studies/time_sync.py): what the maker states about triggering and synchronising the device; null (or absent) when nothing is stated. Each flag null when the maker does not say.

hardware_trigger.description: an external trigger input starts the imagers' exposure

sync_cable.description: several units can be synchronised to each other over a cable

imagers.description: the imagers the trigger or cable reaches (names, or 'depth'); empty = every imager

size_mm.description: [x, y, z] in the device body frame: x along the optical axis (the maker's depth or thickness), y across (width), z up (height).

mounting.description: Mounting holes on the body as the maker's drawing states them (core/brackets.py): per group the thread as written, count, face (back, bottom, top, left, right, front), spacing_mm between the holes (along y on the back, bottom and top faces), max_insert_mm, the group's centre x_mm, y_mm, z_mm in the body frame (null: not dimensioned) and what the source says.

metric.description: What the maker's figure measures: 'rms' an RMS (plane-fit) error, 'median_abs' a median absolute error, 'std_dev' a standard deviation in length units, 'unspecified' the maker does not define it. Missing means unspecified.

area_mm2.description: Optional: the sensing area in mm^2 when the source states an area but no width and height (a curved fingertip).

cable.description: A cable (kind 'cable'): figures from the maker's datasheet; null when not stated. Radii and diameter in mm.

stated_mbps.description: Optional: the data rate the maker states for the cable (Mbit/s); null when not stated.

drag_chain_rated.description: Optional: the maker says the cable is (true) or is not (false) suitable for drag chains; null when not stated.

robotics_rated.description: Optional: the maker says the cable is (true) or is not (false) suitable for robotics (torsion and multi-axis flexing); null when not stated.

practical_mbps.description: Only when a source states it.

ingest.description: Optional: each way cameras reach the host, as its sources state it (USB ports, PCIe, MIPI CSI-2, GMSL, Ethernet); a figure not stated is null. count is the number of ports, links or lanes; per_port_mbps one port's (or link's or lane's) stated rate, aggregate_mbps the stated total, practical_mbps a stated sustained figure per port and practical_aggregate_mbps a stated sustained total. Nothing here is derived from another figure.

light.description: Kind 'light' only (dexvantage/core/lights.py, docs/models/lighting.md): a light source's figures as its maker states them; null when not stated. emitting_size_m is [width, height] of the emitting face (a ring: its outer diameter twice), ring_inner_m a ring's inner diameter, beam_deg a spot's full beam angle, ir_irradiance_w_m2 the in-band IR irradiance at ir_at_m on the light's axis.

cri.description: Optional: the colour rendering index as stated (a lower bound when the maker writes ≥ or +).

illuminance_lux.description: Optional: the on-axis illuminance the maker states at illuminance_at_m (lux).

wavelength_nm.description: Optional: an IR illuminator's stated wavelength (nm).

robot.description: Kind 'robot' only (dexvantage/core/robot/catalogue.py, docs/models/robots.md#catalogue): a robot's figures as its maker states them, each {value, source: an index into sources or null, quote}, value null when no source read states it; the official model it imports from (model) and what DexVantage measured when it imported that model once (verified).

variant.description: Which version of the product the figures describe.

dof.description: Degrees of freedom as the maker counts them: an integer, or [low, high] for configurable versions.

interfaces.description: A list of the interfaces the maker names.

joint_ranges.description: [{joint, min, max}] in 'unit' (deg or rad) as stated.

file.description: The model file the catalogue imports, relative to the folder.

license.description: As core/robot/menagerie.license_name() recognises the folder's LICENSE.

dof_differs.description: Why the model's DoF differs from the maker's, in their words.

teleop.description: Kind 'teleop' only (dexvantage/core/teleop_devices.py, docs/models/teleop.md#library): a teleoperation device's figures as its maker or paper states them, each {value, source: an index into sources or null, quote}, value null when no source read states it. Units: Hz, ms, mm, degrees; workspace in metres in the device frame.

device_kind.description: The teleop study's device kind (core/studies/teleop.py KINDS).

mapping.description: How the device drives a follower: joint to joint (a leader arm) or by a tracked position.

leads.description: Followers the source says the device leads joint to joint, as words matched (ignoring case, spaces, '-' and '_') against a robot's name and model file; '*' for any arm (GELLO is built for its target arm).

same_joints.description: true: the source states the leader has the follower's joints (the same parts or kinematic structure); false: only the joint angles are mapped one to one, and the leader's own joint ranges are not stated.

dof.description: Degrees of freedom the device senses, as the source counts them.

tracking_hz.description: The stated sample, tracking or camera frame rate.

latency_ms.description: The stated latency; the quote says which latency (signal, photon to photon, ...).

workspace.description: The stated workspace as the study's volume ({kind: box | cylinder, center, size} in metres, device frame) or null when the source states none in that shape.

range_text.description: The stated range or field of view, as written.

accuracy_mm.description: The stated position accuracy (the quote says of what).

feedback.description: Force or haptic feedback, as stated (text).

policy.description: Kind 'policy' only (dexvantage/core/policies.py, docs/models/policies.md): the input a robot-learning policy takes, each field {value, source: an index into sources or null}, value null when no source states it.

input_resolution.description: [width, height] px of each image the model takes.

crop_rule.description: none | resize | resize_pad | resize_pad_top_left | center_crop | center_crop_resize (core/policies.py CROP_RULES).

crop_side_fraction.description: center_crop_resize: the fraction of each image side the centred crop keeps.

pre_resize.description: center_crop: [width, height] px the image is resized to before the crop.

patch_px.description: ViT patch edge in input pixels.

wrist_input_resolution.description: [width, height] px when wrist images are sized differently.

execute_steps.description: Actions executed before the next inference.

temporal_ensemble_m.description: m in the weights exp(-m i); false when the source says it uses none.

inference_ms.description: Time for one inference; 'hardware' names what it was measured on.

quote.description: What the source says, verbatim where possible.

pose_stated.description: false: the maker does not state this offset; the pose is a labelled assumption (see note).

resolution.description: Native resolution [w, h] the FOV above refers to.

focal_length_mm.description: Optional: the lens's (effective) focal length as the maker states it, in mm; null or absent when not stated. Checked against the FOV, resolution and pixel size (validation/checks_library.py, data consistency).

sensor_size_mm.description: Optional: the active area [width, height] in mm as the maker states it; null or absent when not stated.

sensor_diagonal_mm.description: Optional: the active area's diagonal in mm as the maker states it (not the nominal optical-format inch figure); null or absent when not stated.

optical_format.description: Optional: the optical format as written (e.g. '1/2.6"'), a nominal type, not a measured size.

figures_conflict.description: Optional: the maker's own figures for this imager disagree with each other (two pages, or angles no centred radially symmetric lens can show together); says which and which figure the entry uses. The data-consistency check reports such imagers instead of failing on them.

exposure_s.description: Optional (core/studies/motion_blur.py, time_sync.py): the manual exposure range the maker states, in seconds; null (or absent) when not stated.

readout_s.description: Optional: the rolling-shutter readout time, first row to last, in seconds, as the maker states it; null when not stated.

fov_modes.description: Optional: FOVs the maker states for stream shapes other than the native one (e.g. a depth FOV for 16:9 and 4:3 streams). A stream of the same aspect ratio uses these.
